messages:
incident-bot: Pager: GeoDNS resolver errors detected in eu-west-1 — elevated SERVFAILs to Cloudflare upstream. Paging @Jordan. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/geodns-fallback

Jordan: I'm on it. seeing spike in client DNS failures and 5xx. Which endpoints? any customer reports?

Sasha: quick snapshot: embeddings and inference endpoints serving from eu-west are affected, some lookups returning SERVFAIL/NX. sample dig:
```
$ dig +short @1.1.1.1 service.prod.redwood-inference.com A
;; ->>HEADER<<- opcode: QUERY, status: SERVFAIL, id: 12345
```

Maria: Observed inconsistent answers from Cloudflare resolver pools in eu-west-1. Route53 authoritative still returning healthy records. GeoDNS health shows increased failovers from 21:12 UTC.

DevOps: opening CF ticket now — https://support.cloudflare.com/ticket/254321. Also preparing manual fallback to route53 if CF doesn't recover quick.

Jordan: customer impact ETA? metrics?

Priya: CS: alerted 3 paying customers, one reports intermittent 502s for a production feature. We're sharing that we're working a network-level workaround.

Sasha: Mitigation plan:
1) Reduce GeoDNS regional TTL 60->10 for eu-west to speed failover
2) Reweight eu-west preference to Route53 (80%) while CF cluster recovers
3) Monitor ERR_RATE and latency

Executing API change:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood-inference.internal/geo/update" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"region":"eu-west-1","preferred":"route53","weight":80,"ttl":10}'
```

DevOps: change applied at 21:17 UTC. Rolling back if CF recovers and stabilizes.

incident-bot: Note: Auto-handoff in 45m to night-oncall. @Jordan you'll have a reminder.

Cloudflare Support: update: Confirmed partial resolver cluster degradation affecting eu-west. We're flushing caches and rerouting; propagation may take up to 10-15m. Ticket 254321 updated.

Maria: Post-change telemetry: traffic shifted ~70% to Route53 in 3m, error rate dropped from 8.3% -> 1.4% in eu-west. Latency normalized. Continuing to monitor for 2 hours.

Jordan: Good. I'll keep alerting customers and will own the postmortem. Please save any console logs and ACLs changes to the incident folder.

Priya: I've updated customer messages: "We've routed traffic around a resolver issue in eu-west; most customers restored. We'll follow up with details and ETA for full restoration."

Sasha: Next steps: confirm CF cluster fully recovered per ticket, revert TTL to normal (60s) and reweight to default gradually. Capture timestamps for timeline.

Jordan: Assigning follow-ups: Sasha (recovery verification), Maria (monitoring and metrics), DevOps (CF ticket follow-through), Priya (customer comms). Postmortem draft due EOD tomorrow.

Jordan: I'm going to annotate the incident timeline and then hand off to night-oncall at 00:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
